name: Collect prices on: schedule: - cron: "*/30 * * * *" # every 30 minutes (GitHub may delay runs a few minutes) workflow_dispatch: # lets you run it manually from the Actions tab permissions: contents: write jobs: collect: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-python@v5 with: python-version: "3.12" - run: python collect.py - name: Commit data run: | git config user.name "price-bot" git config user.email "price-bot@users.noreply.github.com" git add data/snapshots.json git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "Update prices" git push
